programme.notes: There is no 'BASc in Computing and Data Science' at HKU. The computer-science bachelor for international applicants is BEng(CompSc), entered through the umbrella programme 6999 'Computing and Data Science' run by the School of Computing and Data Science; the same programme also leads to BEng(AI&DataSc) and BASc(AppliedAI). A sister programme 6200 'Computing and Data Science (Delta+)' (2.5 years Pokfulam + 1.5 years Shanghai) also exists. The 6999 page itself does not state medium of instruction or campus; the University-wide statement on tl.hku.hk and the School address were used. The programme page on admissions.hku.hk (programmes/undergraduate-programmes/computing-and-data-science) and the BEng(CompSc) page on cs.hku.hk could not be loaded (see access_notes).

english.how_found: Web search 'HKU international qualifications admissions requirements English language non-local' -> admissions.hku.hk English Language Requirement page (and the www. variant): HTTP 503 via fetch tool and TCP connection reset via curl on every attempt. Faculty pages checked instead: ug.hkubs.hku.hk FAQ, www4.fbe.hku.hk FAQ, ugadmissions.engg.hku.hk FAQ, hkumed-ugadmissions.hku.hk, facdent.hku.hk, handbook.hku.hk General Regulations, cds.hku.hk 6999 page and leaflet - none reproduces the University undergraduate IELTS/TOEFL thresholds with numbers.
english.pointer_quote: Applicants should refer to the HKU's admissions webpage (https://admissions.hku.hk/apply/international-qualifications#admissions-standard) for details of the admission requirements and standards applicable to students from different countries with different qualifications.
english.notes: The official page exists (title 'ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT' on admissions.hku.hk) but the whole admissions.hku.hk host was unreachable from this environment, so no verbatim quote could be taken and no value is recorded. UNVERIFIED search-engine snippets of that page (not official text, not to be used as a value) indicate: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with no less than 6.0 in Writing and Speaking in the same attempt; TOEFL iBT 95 with no less than 25 in Writing and Speaking for tests before 21 Jan 2026, and 5.0 overall (new TOEFL scale) for tests on/after 21 Jan 2026; marked 'subject to approval'; test within 2 years of programme start; IELTS Online/Indicator and TOEFL Home Edition not accepted. Programme-specific tables on faculty pages (e.g. HKU Business School) set their own higher benchmarks and were not used. Must be re-checked on the official page.

value.description: HKU publishes programme-specific 'Lower Boundary' expected scores for named international qualifications on the 6999 Computing and Data Science page (IB Diploma, GCE/International A-level, SAT/AP, Indian Board Exams). They are expected competitive scores, not guaranteed minima, and no boundary is published for a Kazakhstan NIS grade-12 diploma; such qualifications are assessed individually.

value.sat_ap: Grade 5 in three AP subjects and SAT superscore 1400 or above (or Grade 4 or above in two additional AP subjects)

gpa.quote: IB Lower Boundary 38 Subject Requirements Grade 6 or better in one of the following subjects: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (HL), Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation (HL)
gpa.quote_2: GCE A-level /International A-level Lower Boundary 2A*1A or better in the best three subjects (English and Chinese language subjects, Critical Thinking, General Studies, Global Perspectives and Research, Knowledge and Enquiry, Project Work, Thinking Skills, and Extended Project Qualification
gpa.how_found: Same 6999 programme page (Entrance Requirements -> Non-JUPAS tab). Corroborated by the Faculty-hosted HKU 'Admissions Standards / Expected lower boundary for admissions' PDF found via web search 'HKU non-JUPAS international qualifications application deadline 2027 intake undergraduate' -> psychology.hku.hk/wp-content/admission/UG/Non-JUPAS.pdf (row 'Computing and Data Science 38 2A* 1A 3AP (Grade 5) + SAT 1400 / 3AP (Grade 5) + 2AP (Grade 4)'), and by ugadmissions.engg.hku.hk/faq/.
gpa.notes: Nature of the figures, verbatim from psychology.hku.hk Non-JUPAS.pdf (HKU Admissions Standards, file dated 2025-10-22): 'The information below refers to school leaving examination scores that are considered competitive for entry to the specific programme. For qualifications that are not listed, reference information can be found on our website.' And from ugadmissions.engg.hku.hk/faq/: 'Requirements vary, depending on the academic qualifications attained. Please visit the Admission Office webpage for the specific certificate requirements relevant to your qualification. The expected score for admission serves as reference only.' No GPA-style threshold and nothing for Kazakhstan NIS is published; the central country-by-country 'admissions standard' page on admissions.hku.hk was unreachable.
